autonomous.approve_done: ✓ Approved: {triggerId} (decision recorded — applied when this trigger is next re-evaluated).

autonomous.enabled_banner:
✓ Autonomous mode enabled ({path}).
  Safety contract: every machine-initiated item passes RBAC → policy → risk gates; approval-required & risk-tagged items PARK for your sign-off — destructive ops never auto-run silently.
  Start: deckent autonomous start · Add work: deckent autonomous backlog add · Review pending: deckent autonomous pending

autonomous.mcp_backlog.description_desc: Task description or directives ref — used by action=add

autonomous.mcp_backlog.title: Autonomous Backlog
autonomous.mcp_engine.action_desc: Action to perform. status=query engine state; start=spawn the real autonomous loop as a detached background process (honest no-op if disabled/already running — see spawned field); stop=write stop marker; backlog_add/list/remove=manage work queue; pending=list parked approvals; approve/reject=resolve a parked trigger.

autonomous.mcp_engine.capability_desc: kind=capability: dotted verb to invoke (e.g. fs.read, db.query) — backlog_add
autonomous.mcp_engine.connector_desc: kind=capability: preferred backend/connector id (e.g. odoo, imap) — backlog_add
autonomous.mcp_engine.cron_desc: 5-field cron expression for backlog_add — entry recurs at this cadence (omit for one-off)
autonomous.mcp_engine.description_desc: Task description or directives ref — used by backlog_add
autonomous.mcp_engine.id_desc: Entry/trigger id — required for backlog_add, backlog_remove, approve, reject
autonomous.mcp_engine.id_required_approv: triggerId (or id) is required for approve
autonomous.mcp_engine.id_required_reject: triggerId (or id) is required for reject
autonomous.mcp_engine.kind_desc: Entry kind (task=inline description, run=directives ref, capability=F8 broker verb). Default: task
autonomous.mcp_engine.policy_desc: Execution policy for backlog_add. Default: auto

task.cmd_desc: Inspect and reconcile immutable one-shot task settlement evidence
task.execution_already_settled: Task {taskId} is immutably settled as NOT_DISPATCHED; dispatch was refused.
task.execution_authority_conflict: Task {taskId} has conflicting immutable execution authority ({reasonCode}); dispatch was refused.
task.execution_fence_conflict: Task {taskId} changed execution state concurrently; dispatch or settlement was refused.
task.execution_snapshot_invalid: Task {taskId} has an invalid canonical execution snapshot; dispatch was refused.
task.settle.already_settled: UNCHANGED — task {taskId} was already settled: raw={rawStatus}, effective={effectiveStatus}, receipt={receiptId}.
task.settle.applied: SETTLED — task {taskId}: raw={rawStatus}, effective={effectiveStatus}, receipt={receiptId}, evidence={evidenceRef}.
task.settle.apply_guard: Refused: --apply requires both --attestation-reason <text> and --operator <id>. No receipt event was appended.
task.settle.desc: Inspect a task settlement plan; apply only with explicit operator attestation
task.settle.dry_run: DRY-RUN — task {taskId}: raw={rawStatus}, effective={effectiveStatus}, decision={decision}, reason={reason}. Re-run with --apply plus explicit attestation only after reviewing the evidence.
task.settle.ineligible: Refused: task {taskId} is not evidence-eligible for reconciliation ({reason}). Nothing was changed.
task.settle.invalid_reason_code: Refused: "{reasonCode}" is not an allowed pre-dispatch reason. Allowed values: {codes}. Nothing was changed.
task.settle.invalid_task_id: Refused: "{taskId}" is not a valid task identifier. Nothing was read or changed.
task.settle.not_found: Task {taskId} or its readable task evidence was not found. Nothing was changed.
task.settle.opt_abandon_dispatch: Terminalize a dispatch that started and then died without a result. The disposition is derived from the absence probe, never chosen: it settles as manual_review_required and refuses while any liveness evidence remains.
task.settle.opt_attestation_reason: Operator-authored reason for the reconciliation (required with --apply)
task.settle.opt_from_result: Terminalize a dispatch whose worker DID finish and persist a result while the caller stopped waiting. The disposition is read from the worker's own selfAssessment, never chosen.
task.settle.opt_json: Emit the stable machine-readable settlement DTO
task.settle.opt_operator: Stable operator identifier; only its hash-bound opaque reference is persisted (required with --apply)
task.settle.opt_reason_code: Typed pre-dispatch reason for a declared eventless receipt ({codes})
task.settle.opt_reproject_status: Make the task file's status agree with its own TERMINAL receipt. Writes nothing new — the receipt is the authority; this only resolves a task surface left behind by a caller that stopped waiting.
task.settle.reason.absence-evidence-inco: absence evidence is incomplete or unknown
task.settle.reason.active-execution-evid: live process, backend, or task artifact evidence is present
task.settle.reason.already-settled: an immutable terminal settlement already exists
task.settle.reason.attestation-evidence-: the attestation does not bind the current absence evidence
task.settle.reason.dispatch-abandoned: dispatch started and the worker is provably gone; eligible for an abandoned-dispatch settlement
task.settle.reason.dispatch-started: dispatch-started evidence exists; NOT_DISPATCHED cannot be asserted
task.settle.reason.dispatch-still-live: liveness evidence remains for this dispatch; it cannot be settled as abandoned
task.settle.reason.legacy-attestation-ve: legacy absence evidence and operator attestation were verified
task.settle.reason.pre-dispatch-reason-r: a typed pre-dispatch rejection reason is required for this declared receipt
task.settle.reason.probe-unsupported: this environment cannot prove every required absence signal
task.settle.reason.receipt-ambiguous: multiple or conflicting receipts prevent a unique decision
task.settle.reason.receipt-dispatch-reje: the immutable receipt proves dispatch was rejected
task.settle.reason.receipt-missing: the expected invocation receipt is missing
task.settle.reason.receipt-ready-for-rej: the declared receipt has no dispatch event and is ready for a typed pre-dispatch rejection
task.settle.reason.scope-mismatch: tenant or project scope does not match the receipt authority
task.settle.reason.task-content-mismatch: the attested task bytes do not match the task evidence
task.settle.reason.terminal-conflict: existing terminal evidence conflicts with this reconciliation
task.settle.reason.unsupported-task-doma: this settlement authority is limited to canonical run-* one-shot tasks
task.settle.reason_code_not_applicable: Refused: --reason-code {reasonCode} is not applicable while settlement authority reports {authorityReason}. Nothing was changed.
task.settle.reason_code_required: This declared receipt has no dispatch event. --reason-code is required to settle it; allowed values: {codes}. Nothing was changed.
task.settle.requested_pre_dispatch_reaso: Requested typed pre-dispatch reason (not yet settled): {reasonCode}
task.settlement.evidence_line: Settlement: raw={rawStatus} · effective={effectiveStatus} · receipt={receiptId} · reason={reasonCode} · evidence={evidenceRefs}
task.settlement.no_receipt_line: Settlement: raw={rawStatus} · effective={effectiveStatus} · receipt=none · reason={reasonCode} · evidence={evidenceRefs}
